sports.name: Football
sports.description: Passing, dribbling, tactical awareness, physical endurance, and teamwork.

sports.name: Cricket
sports.description: Batting technique, bowling precision, fielding agility, and match strategy.

sports.name: Basketball
sports.description: Shooting mechanics, ball handling, defensive footwork, and spatial game sense.

sports.name: Athletics
sports.description: Sprint mechanics, pacing strategy, explosive power, and recovery discipline.
sports.popularPositions: ["100m / 200m Sprint","400m / 800m Middle Distance","1500m / 5000m Long Distance","Hurdles","Long Jump","Relay"]

sports.name: Volleyball
sports.description: Spiking, setting, defensive digs, vertical leap, and court communication.

sports.name: Badminton
sports.description: Smash speed, footwork agility, net play, reaction time, and deception.
sports.popularPositions: ["Singles Specialist","Doubles Front-Court Attacker","Doubles Rear-Court Smasher","Mixed Doubles Specialist"]

sports.name: Tennis
sports.description: Forehand/backhand power, serve precision, stamina, and baseline endurance.

sports.name: Other Sport
sports.description: Multi-disciplinary athletic growth and structured development.

difficultyLevels.name: Beginner
difficultyLevels.label: Beginner
difficultyLevels.description: Practicing for under 1-2 years or just starting structured sports training.

difficultyLevels.name: Intermediate
difficultyLevels.label: Intermediate
difficultyLevels.description: Regular player in school, club, or district level with solid basic foundation.

difficultyLevels.name: Advanced
difficultyLevels.label: Advanced
difficultyLevels.description: Competing at state/national levels or actively aiming for professional sports drafts.

assessments.title: Skills Assessment
assessments.description: Evaluate technical dexterity, precision, ball handling, and sport-specific mechanics.

assessments.title: Fitness Assessment
assessments.description: Evaluate aerobic endurance, explosive agility, core stability, and sprint velocity.
assessments.items: ["Aerobic Capacity (Beep Test)","20m Sprint Velocity","Agility T-Test","Core & Plank Test"]

assessments.title: Knowledge Assessment
assessments.description: Evaluate understanding of game strategy, defensive schemes, positioning, and refereeing rules.
assessments.items: ["Tactical Formations","Offside & Game Rules","Defensive Transition","Set Piece Strategy"]

assessments.title: Performance Assessment
assessments.description: Evaluate real game performance, consistency under pressure, and decision-making speed.
